LanguageData.RR_Operations_NoGame: Company operations are unavailable here. Open a colony save to view its status.
LanguageData.RR_Operations_Inactive: No company branch is established in this save.
LanguageData.RR_Operations_Foundation: This foundation build adds the Operations screen. Company scenarios, the gate, expeditions, and company finances are still in development. Your existing colony continues through its usual controls.
LanguageData.RR_Operations_UnsupportedSave: This save uses a different company record version. Do not re-save it with this build. Keep the original save and use a matching Rimrooms build.
LanguageData.RR_Operations_TabUnavailable: That colony control is unavailable in the current view. Return to a playable colony map and try again.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_Heading: Places this branch runs beyond its headquarters.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_Summary: {0} of {1} sites on the books, costing {2} a day on top of ordinary overhead.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_None: None. Nothing is being paid for, and nothing beyond headquarters is the branch's responsibility.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_RowUnreachable: {0} - on the books but out of reach. It is not being billed while that is true.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_NoCurrentMap: No map in view to register.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_BlockedHeadquarters: This is the headquarters. It is already the branch's own place.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_BlockedCoordinate: A Backrooms coordinate is somewhere you go, not somewhere you keep.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_BlockedNotYours: The branch does not hold this place.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_BlockedTooMany: The branch is running as many places as it can account for.
LanguageData.RR_Site_IsHeadquarters: The headquarters is not a remote site.
LanguageData.RR_Site_CoordinateNotASite: A Backrooms coordinate is a destination, not a base.
LanguageData.RR_Site_NotYours: The branch does not hold that place.
LanguageData.RR_Site_TooMany: The branch cannot account for another site.
LanguageData.RR_Site_NotRegistered: That site is not on the books.
LanguageData.RR_Site_ArrearsOutstanding: The corporation will not put another place on this branch's books while it still owes for the ones it has. Clear the outstanding bill first.
LanguageData.RR_Site_EvictedText:
The corporation has taken {0} off this branch's books. It has gone unpaid for {1} operating days, and the corporation does not carry a branch that will not pay for the places it runs.
Nothing on that map has changed and the colony there is still yours. Clear what is owed and the place can go back on the books at no charge - there is no penalty beyond the place not counting as the branch's own until it is back on the books (connected work, gate anchors and ways out stop treating it as a branch site).
LanguageData.RR_Event_RemoteSiteEvicted: {0} was taken off the books for non-payment.
LanguageData.RR_UI_DestroyDesc: Destroy it outright. It pays nothing and costs nothing, and unlike putting it back it no longer exists anywhere. The one choice that needs no buyer, no contact and nowhere to put it.
LanguageData.RR_UI_DestroyContainedDesc: Stop paying to keep it. The containment charge ends and nothing is paid out, which is why this cannot be used to turn a contained record into money.
LanguageData.RR_UI_Disposition_Destroyed: Destroyed. It no longer exists anywhere.
LanguageData.RR_Disposition_NotContained: That record is not in containment.
LanguageData.RR_Event_ContainmentEnded: A contained record left the branch's custody. Its containment charge has stopped.
LanguageData.RR_UI_Disposition: Contain it and pay to keep it, put it back, or hand it to the corporation. One choice, and it stands.
LanguageData.RR_UI_ContainDesc: Keep it secured and off the exchange. Containment is charged on its own line every day; the branch is paying {0} a day for what it already holds.
LanguageData.RR_UI_ReleaseDesc: Return it to where it came from. It pays nothing and it costs nothing, and the thing is no longer here.
LanguageData.RR_UI_TransferDesc: Hand it over. It pays less than the exchange would, and the corporation has it rather than the branch.
LanguageData.RR_UI_Disposition_Released: Released. It is no longer here.
LanguageData.RR_Disposition_Inactive: The branch cannot act on records right now.
LanguageData.RR_Disposition_RecordUnavailable: That record is not on the branch's books.
LanguageData.RR_Disposition_NotRecovered: The branch does not hold this yet.
LanguageData.RR_Disposition_AlreadyDecided: This has already been decided and it stands.
LanguageData.RR_Disposition_NoContact: There is nobody to hand it to. The branch is out of contact with the corporation.
LanguageData.RR_Event_RecordContained: A record was placed in containment.
LanguageData.RR_Event_RecordTransferred: A record was transferred to the corporation for {0}.
LanguageData.RR_Event_RemoteSiteRegistered: A place beyond headquarters went on the books. It costs something every day now.
LanguageData.RR_Event_RemoteSiteReleased: A place came off the books. No fee, no notice, and the colony there is still the player's own business.
LanguageData.RR_Sites_RowUnstaffed: {0} - on the books and reachable, but nobody is there. Shipments to it will wait.
LanguageData.RR_Founding_Desc: This colony was not founded by the company. It can still register as a branch: the colony stays as it is, its colonists become staff, and the company opens the books, the gate projects and the first survey.
LanguageData.RR_Founding_Unavailable: A branch can only be founded on your home colony, once, when no branch exists yet.
LanguageData.RR_Founding_NoStaff: Nobody here can be put on the books. A branch needs at least one free colonist on this map.
LanguageData.RR_Founding_LetterText: {0} is now on the company's books, with {1} staff. The onboarding survey is accepted and the initial allocation is recorded. Open Operations to see the contracts, the ledger and the gate projects already finished.
